modules.name: Reddot
modules.description: Whole path segments, independent sources, rollback notifications and real UGUI subscription lifetime.

modules.name: ReddotPlayer

modules.name: ReddotSave

modules.name: UnityJson
modules.description: Explicit Json.NET Unity value converters and business-side Save settings; no global JSON defaults or protocol migration.

modules.name: Foundation

modules.name: Core
modules.description: Actual Core lifecycle, authoring and resource fixtures through the complete UPM package. Real OS clipboard acceptance is the separately executed CoreClipboard desktop profile.

modules.name: Domain
modules.description: Quick managed Gameplay/Reddot/Logging logic and distinct Gameplay+Reddot two-Play combination sessions; no repeated Daily gameplay or optional Data/Save probe installation.

modules.name: Gameplay
modules.description: Daily owner of Skill/Buff/Mission/Equipment behavior and pure Gameplay authoring in main+Gameplay only; Special retains its own two-Play and current four-domain publication/Player evidence.

modules.name: Equipment
modules.description: Independent Equipment two-Play exit-hook and settings-admission evidence in main+Gameplay; ordinary behavior and authoring execute in Gameplay Daily.

modules.name: Movement2D
modules.description: Character2D and Platform2D independent runtimes plus main only: actual Physics2D, path lifecycle, serialized events and standalone Player.

modules.name: StateMachine
modules.description: Configured FSM plus main only; native lifecycle, generated state compilation and standalone Player are distinct acceptance layers.

modules.name: Overlap
modules.description: Main plus Overlap only: current Query/Workspace/Detector, Area authoring and Contact events under actual Unity physics. The retired managed legacy guard has no Quick substitute.

modules.name: OverlapPlayer
modules.description: Only main + overlap: new-GUID current prefab, six cold-read persistent Contact callbacks, Area/Unscaled/Destroyed-point contracts, dual-PID Mono Players and native dense workload measurements. No Resource publication.

modules.name: OverlapMovement
modules.description: Declared main + movement2d + overlap native coexistence: real motor/platform colliders and current 3D Box/Sphere union. No historical Behavior acceptance entry.

modules.name: OverlapEditor
modules.description: Overlap authoring and native Editor contracts, without a Player or unrelated features.

modules.name: Behavior
modules.description: Daily authored Detector/Contact and dual-FSM interactions only; Quick retains managed motor/platform mathematics. Standalone physics belongs to Overlap/Movement2D/StateMachine; Special native window input and BehaviorPlayer remain separate.

modules.name: BehaviorPlayer
modules.description: Current authored Behavior producer and serialized Detector/Contact consumers in two actual Mono Players, without the retired main-project receiver.

modules.name: Save
modules.description: Standalone Save plus Newtonsoft only: default Store ownership/configuration, unified business contracts and actual two-process Development Mono and Medium-stripped IL2CPP Players without the main package. Special is fixed .NET BCL only.

modules.name: DataAssets
modules.description: Current DataAssets author-generated roots/rows, identity, resources, formal publication and session contracts; no frozen assembly input or Excel/Localization/Save feature inputs.

modules.name: Localization
modules.description: Localization-only package authoring, lookup, bindings, ResourceImage ownership and real session contracts; no DataAssets/Excel/Save feature inputs.

modules.name: Data

modules.name: Excel
modules.description: Installed optional Excel adapter: real XLSX, ScriptableObject, AssetDatabase, preview and bound data-root contracts.

modules.name: ExcelGameplay

modules.name: LoggingOnly
modules.description: Runtime-only Logger and SingletonSessionState source-slice lifecycle contract with no domain or Gameplay Editor assembly; not formal UPM package isolation.

modules.name: DOTween

modules.name: Help

modules.name: Action
modules.description: Actual Action/Observable execution, cancellation, disposal, pooled reuse, scene shutdown and screen transition lifecycle.

modules.name: Audio

modules.name: Resource

modules.name: AudioNative
modules.description: Original Audio native bundle, PCM output and lifecycle plus current saved inputs in two graphical native Players; separate from Daily and AudioSession.

modules.name: ResourceUpdates

modules.name: ResourceCurrentPublication
modules.description: Current Resource author asset persistence and actual Build/Publish/Deploy consumed by two independent Windows Players; never rewrites frozen migration fixtures.

modules.name: CoreClipboard
modules.description: Real OS/native Unity clipboard acceptance in a tool-owned interactive Editor, never a headless pass.

modules.name: UPM
modules.description: Installed package identity, read-only product layout and Resources contracts without samples or SDKs.

modules.name: Generators
modules.description: Real consumer compilation, independent generator outputs, legacy identity and filesystem ownership acceptance.

modules.description: Approved Git SDK, explicitly imported HybridCLR Module sample and both original test assemblies in an owned host. Editor simulation and compilation are not native Player acceptance.
